Climate Profiles are live! Click [here](https://analytics.cal-adapt.org/climate-profiles/) to learn more. The Analytics Engine team has made an extensive set of pre-generated Climate Profiles available in the [Cal-Adapt: Data Catalog](https://cadcat.s3.amazonaws.com/index.html#climate-profiles/). These annualized hourly climate profiles are available at California HadISD station locations and include both Typical Meteorological Year (TMY/FTMY) and Standard Year 8760 datasets, with median and extreme profiles. Profiles are pre-generated for four energy sector planning horizons: present-day (1.2°C GWL), near-future (1.5°C GWL), mid-century (2.0°C GWL), and mid-late-century (2.5°C GWL). Custom profile generation is supported via the Analytics Engine JupyterHub [here](https://github.com/cal-adapt/cae-notebooks/blob/main/climate-profiles/custom_climate_profiles.ipynb).
